#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Color accessibility audit for design tokens
# Checks all foreground tokens against background for WCAG AA body text (4.5:1 contrast)

TOKENS_FILE="${1:-tokens.json}"

if [[ ! -f "$TOKENS_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "Error: tokens.json not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Extract background and foreground tokens
background=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS_FILE")
foreground=$(jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"' "$TOKENS_FILE")

echo "Auditing design tokens against background: $background"
echo "Target: WCAG AA body text (4.5:1 minimum contrast)"
echo ""

pass_count=0
fail_count=0

while IFS=' ' read -r token_name token_value; do
  # Get contrast ratio using klar
  contrast_output=$(klar contrast "$token_value" "$background" --json 2>/dev/null || echo '{"error": true}')

  if echo "$contrast_output" | jq -e '.error' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    status="ERROR"
    ratio="N/A"
    result="❌ ERROR"
    ((fail_count++))
  else
    ratio=$(echo "$contrast_output" | jq -r '.contrast' 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")

    # Check if ratio meets WCAG AA (4.5:1)
    if (( $(echo "$ratio >= 4.5" | bc -l 2>/dev/null || echo 0) )); then
      status="PASS"
      result="✅ PASS"
      ((pass_count++))
    else
      status="FAIL"
      result="❌ FAIL"
      ((fail_count++))
    fi
  fi

  printf "%-20s %40s  contrast: %6s  %s\n" "$token_name" "$token_value" "$ratio" "$result"
done <<< "$foreground"

echo ""
echo "Summary: $pass_count passed, $fail_count failed"

if [[ $fail_count -gt 0 ]]; then
  exit 1
fi
